relationships.scope: The June 2015 letter follows up the 4 March 2015 direction to constitute a committee for analysing court cases with adverse orders.

limitations: This collection covers Compliance and Legal Cell instructions on how field offices handle legal cases and the Legal Dashboard (2014-2025). Panel advocate empanelment and fees are in the Panel advocates collection; forwarded judgments and individual case orders are not included.
The 16 May 2014 circular is the comprehensive guideline; later circulars reiterate or add to it. No circular here is stated to withdraw it, so the relationships are references, not supersessions.
The Legal Dashboard circulars (2015-2016) are instructions to enter data and are time-bound to the 2015-16 roll-out; no circular here records the dashboard's closure.

The 2018 nodal-office letter refers to an earlier letter of 17 January 2018 that is not in the set; the 2019 service-matters circular refers to circulars of 2017 and March 2019 that are not in the set.
The 2025 Strengthening Litigation Management circular and the 2022 Task Force constitution state no commencement beyond their issue date.
Several scans are low quality; counts and committee compositions should be checked against the page images.
Dates follow the letter, not the issuer listing; entries whose letter date differs carry a date_note.

PDFs were read from the issuer mirror on 4 November 2026 because the public site returned 404 for these paths; recorded SHA-256 values apply to those files. Scanned pages are OCR. Issue dates were checked against the document headers.
